entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Order number is 78-451-B.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order, 78-451-B. And who do I have the pleasure of speaking with?
John. Look, is this going to take long? I just need to know if I can return these or not.
I understand, John. I see the order here for the Pro-Level cycling shoes. Let me just check the delivery date... Okay, it looks like these were delivered 51 days ago.
Right. So can I return them for a refund? Your policy is 90 days.
Yes, you are correct. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days. Before I process this, can I ask what the issue was? Was it an issue with the cleats or the fit of the shoes themselves?
The fit. They gave me terrible blisters after just one ride. I'm not interested in an exchange, I just want my money back.

I'm very sorry to hear that the shoes weren't comfortable for you. I can absolutely process that refund. I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label to send the cycling shoes back to us.
Okay, good. So a full refund?
Yes, a full refund to your original payment method once the item is received at our warehouse. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
